fixture.description: Synthetic JSONL of hosted-shaped seeds (about 4.2 KB each, large execution_recipe the scorer never reads), half carrying metadata.tenant_id, written at the 33.6 MB size of /data/source-ingest/distill_seeds.jsonl
fixture.host: single local process, python 3.12; relative magnitudes matter, hosted absolute times are for the operator acceptance task

measured_before_whole_store_request.reading: Cold store load (index of the whole file) and parsing/serialising every seed exceed the 2.0 s interactive limit together; transfer size is 8.5 MB per read. A tenant without metadata.tenant_id adds three tenant-wide evidence listings per request.

measured_after_paged_match_projection.reading: Per-page work is a slice of the cached order plus point reads for that slice; no seed object is built and no tenant-wide listing runs. The one-time cold index load (1.45 s) is not removed by paging; it now happens once inside a 10 s background page budget instead of the 2 s interactive limit, and is shared across pages.

runtime_budget_per_persona_cycle.before: 1 request per open demand; server parses every stored seed, lists tenant evidence, returns about 8.5 MB (full fixture, tenant slice of 2000 seeds); client limit 2 s
runtime_budget_per_persona_cycle.after: at most PERSONA_DISCOVERY_SEED_MAX_PAGES=50 requests per open demand, page_size 100, about 25 KB each (about 1.2 MB cap, 2 MB for the full 2000-seed tenant slice); per-page timeout 10 s; total read budget 60 s; server scan cap 1000 records per request
runtime_budget_per_persona_cycle.stop_rule: stops when next_page_token is empty; otherwise a page cap or the 60 s budget ends the read as partial

design.endpoint: GET /api/source-ingest/management/strategy-seeds accepts page_size (max 200), page_token, fields=match|full. Without them the response is unchanged.
design.stability: Token is an ordinal plus a digest of the last scanned seed id (no seed id leaks across tenants); order is store insertion order so appended seeds arrive after the cursor; if the cursor seed was pruned the ordinal is used.
design.event_loop: The route is a sync def and runs in the server threadpool; a test asserts it is not a coroutine function.
design.match_projection: Only fields and metadata keys read by persona_strategy_discovery._candidate_from_seed and _score_candidate; a test proves scoring on the projection equals scoring on full rows.
design.partial: Discovery records partial, seeds_seen, seed_pages and partial_reason on the demand last_run; with no match the reason is partial_seed_read:<n>_seeds_seen_no_match_yet and no data backfill action is raised. A page that fails raises, so discovery_unavailable:<error> is still recorded.
design.tenant_and_credential_rules: Same _require_seed_caller and per-seed ownership rule (metadata/lineage tenant, else source record, bundle, evidence item point reads). Wrong tenant gets nothing.
